name: origin-ui-popover
blurb: Anchored float content with directional slide-in and optional arrow.
description: Radix Popover wrapper with directional slide animations and zoom. Positions relative to trigger with configurable side and alignment. Supports optional arrow and customizable portal styling.
use_when: You need quick settings or contextual info next to a button without obscuring much content.
avoid_when: Mobile layouts where popovers may overflow — consider a modal drawer instead.
a11y: Full Radix Popover accessibility: click to open, Escape to close, focus management. Supports anchored positioning to non-trigger elements.
